pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. One whole laptop with blank blue screen and blank unlettered keyboard, one smartphone and small two-antenna router all connected by blue lines to a globe with blue ocean green continents above them. INTERNET concept, flat solid fills dark outlines, no letters, URLs, app logos, numbers, text or people. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.

alt.ca: Un portàtil, un mòbil i un encaminador connectats a un globus terraqüi.
alt.es: Un portátil, un móvil y un rúter conectados a un globo terráqueo.
